name: Wyzer
description: Wyzer is a new programming language that hit Show HN on 7 August and earned 226 HN points that week. Beyond the buzz, it is an interesting test case for what a modern language design can look like when it starts from scratch rather than incrementing an existing ecosystem. 220 stars and a strong HN showing in the same week.
highlights: 226 HN points from its Show HN
Worth watching as a language-design test case
curatorNote: New languages rarely get traction; Wyzer pulled 226 HN points out of the gate. Whether it keeps momentum or not, the design choices are worth studying.
